Radiology Report
Date: 08/21/2026
Patient: Edmond Corwin, 78-year-old male

Examination: MRI Lumbar Spine

Findings:
MRI lumbar spine 08/21/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.

Impression:
There is a herniated disc at the L4-L5 level causing moderate narrowing of the right neural foramen and impinging on the exiting nerve root. No other significant abnormalities are noted in the lumbar spine.

Recommendations:
Clinical correlation is advised to assess symptoms related to the nerve root compression. Further management should be guided by the referring physician.
